## What's going on with this data?

## Dynamic fuel price report



```{r}
logged_data <- read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vQiIzzEa285Fm2_nqe2hwOgCXOI06EQZIuJOZ--NPF0py1zwvVpP-okzb3oqj50TRUJZizMq3IIpr1F/pub?gid=0&single=true&output=csv")

latest_data <- logged_data %>%
  rename(
    record_date = date,
    time_of_day = time_period,
    fuel = fuel_type
  )

```
## Summary of the data

A total of r nrow(latest_data) fuel price records were collected.

The average recorded fuel price is r round(mean(latest_data$price, na.rm = TRUE), 2) dollars per litre.

The minimum recorded fuel price is r round(min(latest_data$price, na.rm = TRUE), 2) dollars per litre.

The maximum recorded fuel price is r round(max(latest_data$price, na.rm = TRUE), 2) dollars per litre.

There are r length(unique(latest_data$station)) unique petrol stations in this dataset.

The average recorded fuel price is `r round(mean(latest_data$price), 2)` !

## Average price by fuel type
```{r}
latest_data %>%
  group_by(fuel) %>%
  summarise(avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fuel, y = avg_price)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Price by Fuel Type",
    x = "Fuel Type",
    y = "Average Price"
  )

```

## Number of records by station
```{r}
latest_data %>%
  count(station) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = station, y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Records by Station",
    x = "Station",
    y = "Count"
  )

```

## Average price by station
```{r}
latest_data %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  summarise(avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = station, y = avg_price)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Price by Station",
    x = "Station",
    y = "Average Price"
  )

```

## Average price by time of day
```{r}
latest_data %>%
  group_by(time_of_day) %>%
  summarise(avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time_of_day, y = avg_price)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Price by Time of Day",
    x = "Time of Day",
    y = "Average Price"
  )

```
